rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Heat Q = mcΔT; specific heat c, thermal capacity C = mc, heat capacity per mole = C. molar.  ·  Latent heat L: Q = mL (change of state at constant T). Calorimetry: heat lost = heat gained.
